summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CRM system. Login functionality works perfectly, frontend UI is well-designed with proper navigation and error handling. Critical backend issue identified: database connection failing with DNS resolution error, causing all data-related API endpoints to return 500 errors.

critical_bugs.issue: Supabase database connection failing with 'Name or service not known' error

passed_tests: Frontend error handling and graceful degradation
UI design - light green theme (#2B593F), clean layout, proper spacing
